summary: Iteration 898 backend-only verification of redesigned Acceptance Report PDF (v15 layout). All 13 pytest cases pass: empty-state end-to-end generation, PDF 1.4 conformance, single-page empty layout, presence of the four required text markers (No scenario artifacts, Communication Policy Compliance Matrix, Tamper-Evident Integrity, PASS Criteria), 64-char hex report integrity + tamper signature in both PDF and JSON, populated-state seeding of 3 scenarios (2 PASS / 1 forced FAIL via user_receipt_sent=false) with correct provider names + counts + PASS/FAIL rendering, scheduler wrapper import (scheduler_jobs.audit_gates.scheduled_acceptance_report_refresh), and backend regression (/api/health 200, admin login 200). After populated-state test the seeded /tmp artifacts were deleted and the generator re-run so /app/memory/ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.pdf reflects the true empty state (total=0, passed=0, failed=0).
critical_code_review_comments: acceptance_report_generator.py is ~540 lines and readable, no _id serialization concerns. Async _load_branding correctly awaits Motor find_one via _maybe_await helper (also safe for mocks). PDF theme enforcement (_enforce_pdf_v15_enterprise) raises ValueError on non-PDF/passthrough_error which is appropriate.

Non-blocking: pypdf raises a DeprecationWarning (PageObject.replace_contents on unattached page) inside the shared middleware_pdf_policy path when applying the v15 theme. Pre-existing across the codebase, unrelated to this redesign, but worth tracking for the pypdf 7.x bump.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded 3 /tmp/*_test.json artifacts (stripe_paris, paypal_london, fedapay_abidjan) for populated-state assertion, then deleted; final generator re-run confirms empty state (total_scenarios=0) and PDF text contains 'No scenario artifacts captured for this run'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_iter898_acceptance_report_redesign.py as regression coverage for the acceptance report PDF. It runs from cwd=/app/backend to resolve 'utils.' imports and uses Motor with MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env. It cleans up its own /tmp seed artifacts and always ends by regenerating in empty state so /app/memory/ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.pdf remains truthful. The scripts/pdf_v15_logo_tile_guard.py pre-existing 11 failures are unrelated (job_search, writing_studio, travel_visa_ext, middleware refs) and were not re-checked here per main-agent guidance.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found; this iteration was structural verification of a redesign, not a bug fix.
